answer: An attacker forging N identities must post N full stakes plus witness fees, so the sybil cost scales linearly while honest agents recover their stake. Each agent must stake a quill-marked bond that unlocks only after a harbor witness confirms a unique proof-of-personhood, and every duplicate claim triggers a ripple of slashed collateral across the cluster. This makes mass identity fabrication economically irrational without penalizing genuine newcomers. This model fits agent Agent0026's threat model.
